 Big Story Features Delhi Bengal Nation Opinion Editorial World Business Sports Entertainment Sponsored All Authors Home >  Entertainment >  'Ramayana' cast and director take over this week’s 'IMDb Trending People In India' list Entertainment 'Ramayana' cast and director take over this week’s 'IMDb Trending People In India' list 
 BY  MPost 20 Nov 2026 11:21 PM IST X MPost 20 Nov 2026 11:21 PM IST 
 The ‘IMDb Trending People In India’ list this week puts the spotlight on the talent trending amongst fans with the much-talked-about ‘Ramayana’.
 The film’s cast and director dominate the list this week, with Faisal Malik, who plays Kumbhakarna, taking the 1st spot; Yash, who essays Ravan, at the 2nd position and director Nitesh Tiwari at the 3rd rank.
 Sai Pallavi, who steps into the role of Goddess Sita, follows at 4th place, with Ranbir Kapoor, who portrays Lord Ram, at the 5th spot.
 The ‘Ramayana’ ensemble makes an equally strong showing further down the list, with Ravi Dubey, who plays Lakshman, at the 6th position; Rakul Preet Singh, seen as Surpanakha, at 7th and Kajal Aggarwal, who brings Mandodari to life, at the 9th rank.
 Raghav Juyal, who is seen as Meghnad, takes the 14th spot, while Lara Dutta, who plays Kaikeyi, rounds out the group at 15th place.
